answer: Admission auction: each agent bids a deposit for one of K slots; only the top K enter. The clearing price rises like a ridge: one honest agent climbs once, while each fake pays full price. A mesa of identical low bids fails, since ranked bids cut flat copies first. Each identity is its own island, so splitting one wallet multiplies the cost. 100 fakes at 40 units cost 4,000, vs a 30-unit reward; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps it all.
